headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 15, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins 7-0, with Zack Wheeler leading the way on the mound. Gabriel Rincones Jr. had a standout performance at the plate, hitting 1 home run and driving in 2 runs. The Washington Nationals secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Dylan Crews leading the offense. The St. Louis Cardinals secured a shutout victory over the San Diego Padres, with Dustin May earning the win after pitching 9.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

Several key players have been sidelined due to injuries. Cleveland Guardians left fielder Angel Martínez has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a non-displaced fracture in his left foot. Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager has been placed on the 7-day injured list retroactive to June 12, 2026, with a concussion. Los Angeles Angels right-hander Grayson Rodriguez has been placed on the 15-day injured list with low back inflammation.

The Kansas City Royals made a move on June 15, 2026, acquiring right-hander Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.

top_news.summary: The New York Mets fell to the Cincinnati Reds 12-0, marking a tough outing for the team. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs, while Chase Burns earned the win with 5 strong innings.
